Who We Are

Once a Knight,
Always a Knight

The St. Michael-Albertville Youth Football organization is dedicated to fostering a nurturing environment where young athletes in grades 2/3–6 can develop their skills, sportsmanship, and teamwork.

We offer a competitive Travel League for players in grades 2/3–6 looking to develop their skills at a higher level. Running a simplified version of the STMA Varsity Knights playbook, with Saturday games ending in mid-October.

All teams are coached by dedicated volunteer parents. The Travel program includes year-round engagement — community events, optional off-season practices, and more. Questions? Email us at STMAYouthFootball24@gmail.com

The Program

Travel Football.
Built for Every Grade.

Travel League
Competitive · Grades 2/3–6

Part of the North Star Youth Football League — a 9-team North Metro league including STMA, Elk River, Rogers, Becker, Big Lake, Monticello, Zimmerman, Rockford, and St. Francis. Year-round engagement with community events, off-season practices, and Head Coach + 3–4 assistant coaches per team.

🏈 Visit North Star Youth Football League

By Grade

2nd/3rd
Grade

Introduction to fundamentals — blocking, catching, and basic play concepts in a fun, low-pressure setting.

4th
Grade

Building on the basics with structured offensive and defensive formations. Players learn to compete and communicate.

5th
Grade

A more competitive level with expanded playbooks, positional training, and a stronger emphasis on teamwork.

6th
Grade

The capstone year. Players develop leadership skills and prepare for the step up to middle school football.
